hook: Telling people your biggest goals gives your brain cheap dopamine that sabotages your hunger to achieve them.
full_script: Telling people your biggest goals gives your brain cheap dopamine that sabotages your hunger to achieve them. The moment you announce your next big move at the dinner table, your subconscious tricks itself into believing the victory is already won. You collect applause for work you haven't bled for. Worse, you tip off competitors who now have months to build roadblocks while you are still basking in verbal admiration. Real leverage is constructed in darkness, not press conferences. The people who boast the loudest about what they are about to conquer are usually running from the terrifying silence of execution. Suffocate your pride until your bank account and your results make the announcement for you. Move like a shadow, strike like lightning.
